summary: Tested the new corporate Deck builder end-to-end. All 21 backend pytest cases pass (auth guards, preview, regenerate-intro, create with slug format <slug>-<6hex>, list sorted desc, patch, delete, public GET increments view_count, 404s). Full frontend flow verified: admin login -> Decks tab -> NewDeckDialog (client name 'TEST Patagonia') -> live LLM preview rendered (Claude Sonnet 4.5 intro, ~150 chars) -> regenerate produced a different intro -> save persists -> deck card appears in grid with copy/open/delete -> public /deck/<slug> renders BlackRock deck with personalized slide 1 (overline 'CONFIDENTIAL - PREPARED FOR TEST PATAGONIA', headline 'A Corporate Gifting Presentation for TEST Patagonia.', AI intro paragraph, no client logo tile because DuckDuckGo had no Patagonia icon — graceful degradation working). Unknown slug shows 'This presentation isn't available' empty state. /blackrock regression: still renders default 'BlackRock' client with no client logo tile. CSV export correctly hidden on Decks tab, visible on Waitlist/Inquiries/Newsletter. Homepage regression OK. Cleanup: deleted my TEST Patagonia deck; pre-existing Microsoft + Acme Coffee decks left intact.

issues: Shows a square 'no logo' placeholder tile in the preview when DuckDuckGo can't resolve an icon. The public deck page hides it entirely (correct), but the preview shows the placeholder. Cosmetic only — admin still sees what the public will see (no logo). Consider hiding the placeholder in the dialog too for consistency.

action_items: Optional polish only: hide the 'no logo' placeholder tile in NewDeckDialog preview when logo_url is null (to match the public deck behavior which already hides it).
Optional UX: the public deck URL /deck/<slug> is shareable but doesn't expose a 'Visit Not A Salami' empty-state for invalid slugs has correct CTA already.
critical_code_review_comments: decks.py: lookup_domain prefers exact case-insensitive name match — good. But for 'TEST Patagonia' or any test name there is no Clearbit match so domain ends up None and logo_url is None. That's the expected best-effort behavior already documented.

server.py admin_create_deck: makes two LLM-adjacent network calls (Clearbit lookup_domain + Claude generate_intro) sequentially inside the POST. With typical Claude latency that's a 4-15s request. Acceptable for an admin-only endpoint but worth noting — frontend already shows a loading state.

server.py PATCH /admin/decks/{id}: uses Pydantic DeckUpdate with Optional fields. Note that explicitly setting a field to null in the JSON body will be filtered out by `v is not None` — so admins cannot clear logo_url/intro_text via PATCH, only overwrite. Probably intentional, but worth flagging.

Deck.created_at is stored as an ISO string (not a real datetime). Sort by 'created_at' descending works because ISO 8601 strings are lexically sortable. Same approach used for other entities in the codebase — consistent.

frontend Admin.jsx (~720 lines including NewDeckDialog + DecksPanel) is now at the 700-line threshold. Consider extracting NewDeckDialog and DecksPanel into their own files in /app/frontend/src/components/admin/ for maintainability.

Logo-fetch failures (DuckDuckGo returning 404 for niche/test domains) are handled gracefully on the public page (logo tile hidden via clientLogo conditional) and the admin still sees a 'no logo' placeholder in the dialog preview — a minor cosmetic inconsistency, not a bug.
